SQL_fingerprints.sql: SELECT DISTINCT "_t0"."arch_type" AS "arch_type", "_t0"."arch_module" AS "arch_module" FROM "anchors" AS "_t0" WHERE ("_t0"."kind" = CAST($1 AS text)) ORDER BY "_t0"."arch_type" ASC, "_t0"."arch_module" ASC
SELECT doc FROM identity_users WHERE user_id = $1
BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.version,
               CASE WHEN a.kind = 'NodeAnchor' THEN
                   (SELECT string_agg(e.id::text, ',' ORDER BY e.seq, e.id)
                      FROM anchors e WHERE e.src = a.id OR e.dst = a.id)
               END
        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.version,
               CASE WHEN a.kind = 'NodeAnchor' THEN
                   (SELECT string_agg(e.id::text, ',' ORDER BY e.seq, e.id)
                      FROM anchors e WHERE e.src = a.id OR e.dst = a.id)
               END
        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

SELECT n1.id, e1.id, n1.arch_type, n1.arch_module FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS f0(id, ord) LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND (e1.src = f0.id OR (e1.undirected AND e1.dst = f0.id)) AND (e1.arch_type = $2 OR e1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $2)) JOIN anchors n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND n1.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n1.root_id = CAST($3 AS uuid) OR (n1.props->'access'->>'all')::int > -1 OR (n1.props->'access'->'roots'->'anchors') ? CAST($4 AS text) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM anchors ge WHERE ge.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ge.src = CAST($3 AS uuid) AND (n1.props->'access'->'groups'->'anchors') ? CAST(ge.dst AS text))) ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id LIMIT 2049
